queue.question: Which modern procedural noise and field-composition methods are measurably better than current KAOPU typed-wave primitives for multiscale natural structure?
queue.progress: R01 primary-source review rejected a universal noise ranking and identified footprint/filter policy as a missing contract. R31 executed the existing typed-wave footprint probe: raw point sampling RMSE was 0.0644793 against exact cell averages, while numerical quadrature matched the analytic sinc average at RMSE 0.00004546. R31 then inspected fixed Tiles Mother commit 95c97a9: its shader derives a footprint from dFdx/dFdy and applies band(fp,scale), but grain and micro paths apply the same gate during assignment and again in structuralHeight. Therefore repeated filtering is a real non-idempotent response choice, not yet a proven production bug. No GPU/browser/iPhone or visual acceptance occurred; R1 and production Mothers remain unchanged.
